fit.title: operating cash flow
fit.reason: Operating revenue, margins, cash conversion and reinvestment drive value; business-specific accounting and financing adjustments remain necessary. A one-for-two reverse split followed the Aerospace separation. The Q2 filing retrospectively adjusts share and per-share amounts, but its operating results still include Aerospace; share restatement does not establish post-separation business comparability. The Aerospace business was separated on June 29. Honeywell’s nominal June 30 quarter actually closed June 27 and still consolidates Aerospace as continuing operations. Discontinued-operation presentation starts in Q3. Predecessor revenue, margins, cash flows, debt and payout history cannot be treated as those of the remaining automation company without a matched post-separation reconciliation.
